context.description: Add the six fault folders under task-formats/blend

evidence.trustReason: Layer 3 review of blend.test.ts describe 'the fault folders (D14)' (unchanged since 6a48982b6d) against tasks.md T3.5. Ran bun test test/task/blend.test.ts: 62 pass, 0 fail; -t 'the fault folders': 7 pass, 26 expect calls. (1) format-faults: toEqual on the exact ordered list R1 notes.txt, R3 T1.1 TASK.md unknown key 'colour', R4 T1.2 TASK.md no H1, plus spec undefined - proves the three rules, loader order (VF9, spec deviation 6) and nothing else. (2) cycle: exact single R7 'order has a cycle: T1.1 -> T1.2 -> T1.1'. (3) self-after: exact single R7 'T1.1 -> T1.1'. (4) unknown-after: exact single R6 'after names unknown task T7'. (5) no-ensures: exact single R3 at T1.2 VERIFY.md "'ensures' is a required property". (6) outside-run: failures [], tasks/after [[T1,[]],[T1.1,[]],[T1.2,[T1.1]]], gates [BUILD-1], outside {}. (7) Boundary: exact file inventory per folder (SPEC.md, one parent, two leaves, plus notes.txt only in format-faults; no .ts) and the exact failure lists prove the loader reports only planted rules. The loader stops cross-file rules after an R1-R4 failure, so the test alone cannot see hidden cross-file faults in format-faults/no-ensures, and 'one gate' is asserted only on outside-run; I closed this independently: diff -r of each folder against outside-run shows only the planted lines and SPEC.md prose differ, and scratch copies with the faults repaired load with zero failures and gates [BUILD-1]. A mutation (extra unknown gate in the cycle copy) adds an R6 that the toEqual would catch. Planted lists are literal constants, not derived from loader output. RED commit 8082522761 precedes the folders (absent at that tree). Minor note: tasks.md Notes name fault-folders.test.ts, but the binding Tests field is blend.test.ts, where the cases live.
